name: KDE Plasma / Qt
concept: Element as a native KDE application on Plasma, modelled on NeoChat (KDE's own Matrix client): unified header band with circular window buttons, a space column beside a Kirigami room list, white Breeze cards on the Window canvas and exact Breeze widget rules from breezehelper.cpp. Pure variants are faithful Breeze Light/Dark/Daylight; the time axis goes back to KDE 4 Oxygen and forward to the VDG's Ocean design system; usable strips decoration for long sessions, glass turns it into a blurred, glowing Plasma showcase.

sources.title: Ocean design system (colour schemes, component specs, icons, window decoration)
Ocean Design for Plasma – May updates

limits: Element Call and widgets are iframes: only light/dark base follows (glass and breeze-dark = dark, others light).
The window titlebar is decorative (browser tab); only maximise works (fullscreen). Hidden in standalone/desktop display-mode.
Compound icons are inline SVG: Breeze/Ocean/Oxygen icons are swapped per button via aria-label/mx_ class masks; other locales and unknown buttons keep recoloured Compound icons.
Plasma's per-user accent colour and real 'accent from wallpaper' cannot be read; fixed #3daee9 (glass: fixed violet #7f6df2).
Data-URL default avatars in notifications/favicon keep Element's palette.
Kirigami column paging (sliding page rows) is approximated by Element's own responsive layout; React-owned DOM is not moved.
backdrop-filter is expensive: glass limits blur to ~6 large panes and falls back to opaque Breeze Dark without support.

variants.name: Breeze · Light
variants.tagline: Element as a native Plasma 6 app — NeoChat's layout in exact Breeze Light.
variants.motion: Breeze hover fades 150ms, KWin-style fade/scale popups
signature: Unified #dee0e2 titlebar+header band with circular chevron window buttons (red circle close on hover)
Light-grey Window canvas with white 5px View message cards (NeoChat)
Plasma-blue #3daee9 selection at 30% alpha plus 1px outline on rooms, spaces, menus, settings tabs
Breeze push buttons: 1px outline, 12.5% hairline shadow, outline turns #3daee9 on hover; tinted check boxes with blue tick
Kirigami 'Favourite ———— ⌃' section headers, ring-initials avatars, plain unread counts, KDE-logo home button

regions.shell: Window #eff0f1 canvas; 30px Breeze titlebar overlay in Header #dee0e2; one 48px Header band across space column, room list and room header (unified, no separator)
regions.spaces: 52px icon column #e3e5e7, KDE logo on Home, selected space = 30% accent tile r5 + 3px accent edge line (Plasma task-manager indicator), Plasma digital clock at bottom
regions.roomlist: Kirigami sidebar on Window: 52px rows, 32px round avatars, bold unread names, 'Favourite ——— ⌃' section rules, selection 30% accent + 1px #3daee9 outline r5
regions.header: Header band #dee0e2, room name 15px 600, flat 34px tool buttons with Breeze icons that gain an outline/fill on hover
regions.timeline: Window #eff0f1 canvas, messages as View #ffffff cards r5 with hairline shadow; own card tinted 15% accent; mention card neutral tint + 3px #f67400 bar; IRC = flat View with #f7f7f7 zebra rows
regions.names-avatars: Round avatars; initials = HIG hue text + 1px ring on 15% tint; bold usernames in darkened HIG hues
regions.composer: View #ffffff strip under a 1px separator; Breeze line edit (r5, #c6c8c9 outline, accent border on focus); flat tool buttons attach/emoji/voice; send = document-send tool button
regions.rightpanel: Window page with Kirigami headings, hairline group frames, flat list delegates with 30% accent selection
regions.buttons: Breeze push button: Button bg, 1px #d1d1d2 outline, r5, 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0/.125); hover/focus pen #3daee9; pressed mix 30% accent; default button accent-tinted; destructive = #da4453 text + outline
regions.inputs: View fill, 1px #c6c8c9 outline r5, 6px padding; focus = 1px #3daee9 border + 2px focus-visible ring; check box r4 with 30% accent fill and blue tick; toggle = Breeze switch (accent track)
regions.dialogs: Window sheet r5, title in Header band, 0 4px 14px rgb(0 0 0/.25) + outline; KDE button order (Help left, OK/Apply/Cancel right, default tinted)
regions.menus: View popup r5, 4px margins, item highlight 30% accent + outline, separators hairline; tooltips Tooltip colours r5 with soft shadow
regions.settings: System-Settings layout: left icon+label sidebar (30% accent selection), pages on Window, group boxes as hairline frames, Breeze tabs with 3px accent underline
regions.auth: Plasma lock-screen feel: Hanabi wallpaper light behind a centred Breeze card (r5), Noto Sans, big clock heading
regions.scrollbars: 8px groove-less pill, text colour at 50%, turns #3daee9 on hover; hidden arrows
regions.focus: 2px #3daee9 outline at 1px offset (thicker than pure Breeze 1px for WCAG)
regions.badges: Unread counts as plain right-aligned numbers; highlight/mention = #da4453 pill white text; dots in accent
regions.code: Hack 13px on View alternate #f7f7f7 r5 with outline; KSyntaxHighlighting Breeze Light colours
regions.iframes: Element base light; widget/call frame styled as Breeze group box (r5, outline)
regions.icons: Breeze 22px monochrome (LGPL) via mask-image + currentColor on known buttons; Compound icons recoloured elsewhere
regions.motion: 150ms ease-out outline/fill fades (Breeze hover animation), popups fade+scale .96→1 150ms, menus slide 4px; off under reduced motion

variants.enhancer: Breeze titlebar overlay (chevrons, title mirrors document.title, maximise toggles fullscreen) + Plasma digital clock in the space column
